response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong D-language, distributed systems, and geospatial project experience (GISCollective), but his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js web development, with only brief and dated (2014-2015) exposure to C/C++ and no evidence of Rust. He lacks demonstrated recent, deep C++/Rust production experience and direct routing/navigation-tile pipeline work required for this role.
strengths: Deep distributed-systems and low-latency service experience (Dlang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices at Sociomantic)
Personal/open-source geospatial platform experience (GISCollective) showing genuine passion for GIS domain
Broad technical range and demonstrated ability to quickly pick up new stacks and technologies
concerns: No current or recent (post-2015) C++ experience, and no evidence of Rust experience at all
No direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance systems, or tile-based data pipelines
Career trajectory has moved further into TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work, away from systems-level programming

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent C++/Rust production experience
Relevant geospatial side-project (GISCollective) and distributed systems background
